items.title: Silver’s 55% plunge fails to spark festive buying
items.summary: Fears of further price drops and broader economic pressures are keeping consumers away from silver coins and bars, though jewellery continues to hold up.

items.title: Indian stocks see weakest market breadth in seven months as oil prices, bond yields weigh
items.summary: October market breadth touched its lowest level since April 2026 as advancing stocks lagged decliners amid global risk-off sentiment. Is elevated crude Geopolitical escalation will further weaken it

items.title: JPMorgan Asset Sees Yuan Gaining 10% as Global Push Deepens
items.summary: China’s push to internationalize the yuan has entered a “steady, slow, but nonstop” phase that is likely to support further gains in the currency, according to JPMorgan Asset Management.

items.title: Shanghai Exchange Halts Duty-Free Metal Delivery Against Futures
items.summary: The Shanghai Futures Exchange has suspended the settlement of copper and aluminum futures with deliveries from duty-free warehouses, a mechanism that has long helped Chinese traders avoid paying taxes on metal that can be sold overseas.

items.title: US Markets Today: US stocks end lower as Alphabet revenue miss revives AI capex jitters
items.summary: Wall Street ended the day on a sour note, as Alphabet's revenue shortfall cast a shadow over the AI investment landscape and overall market stability. The Nasdaq Composite was hardest hit, plummeting by 1.36 percent. Although the economy shows robust growth, investor focus shifted to inflation numbers and corporate profitability, which displayed resilience.

items.title: Warsh’s ‘Forward Silence’ Risks Bigger Treasury Market Swings
items.summary: Investors are worried that Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh’s plan to reduce the number of interest-rate decisions each year could be a recipe for more volatility in the $32 trillion Treasury market.

items.title: Unauthorised cross-border crypto transfers: Why ED searched Mudrex and Instadapp; what is the case?
items.summary: An ED investigation into alleged foreign exchange violations involving crypto transfers above ₹4,900 crore has brought Mudrex and Instadapp under scrutiny.

items.title: Cash takes centre stage as investors rethink AI spending boom
items.summary: Investors are increasingly focused on technology companies' cash generation capabilities to fund artificial intelligence investments. Microsoft and Oracle are gaining positive attention from investors, while Alphabet faces challenges due to rising AI costs. Alphabet's spending has surpassed its operating cash flow, raising concerns about its financial sustainability. In contrast, Microsoft's strong cash flow and…

items.title: World’s No. 2 Gold Miner Says Diesel Risks Driving Up 2027 Costs
items.summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd. warned that rising diesel prices risk raising the cost of producing gold by as much as $80 per ounce next year, signaling mounting inflationary pressures for the mining industry.

items.title: Tata Group’s November test: Chandrasekaran’s reappointment row and Mehli Mistry’s November 5 hearing
items.summary: Noel Tata is questioning N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment process and seeking board records. Separately, former trustee Mehli Mistry has challenged trust governance and Noel’s eligibility, while the trusts dispute his legal standing.

items.title: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh says fare hikes unavoidable amid fuel cost surge as airline posts ₹1,879.1 crore Q2 loss
items.summary: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh said rising fuel costs will make higher airfares unavoidable and forecast low single-digit capacity growth in the December quarter. It plans to adjust aircraft deployment based on demand & costs, with reductions focused more on international routes.

items.title: Alphabet loses over $500 billion in market value as AI hits Google search
items.summary: Alphabet lost over $500 billion in market value as weaker-than-expected search and advertising sales raised concerns over AI's impact on Google's core business and soaring infrastructure costs.

The firm might be burdened with nearly $98.5 billion in contingent commitments, including data center leases and chip system repurchases. There are growing apprehensions about the sustainability of Google Cloud's expansion due to a substantial backlog from its collaboration with…

items.title: IMF flags Super El Niño risks to India’s growth, says impact yet to materialise
items.summary: According to the IMF, India continues to act as a significant growth engine within the global economy. Despite looming threats posed by weather phenomena like Super El Nino, these risks have yet to materialize. Recent adjustments have raised growth forecasts to 7 percent for the fiscal years 2027 and 2028, reflecting robust domestic demand and a thriving service sector.

items.title: Cognizant trims 2026 revenue growth guidance again amid macro uncertainty
items.summary: Cognizant cuts its 2026 constant-currency growth forecast to 4-4.4 per cent amid weak discretionary spending, even as Q3 revenue rises 4.6 per cent and net profit reaches $627 million.

items.title: Economy can sustain high-growth trajectory in FY27, recent GST reforms to help: Finmin review
items.summary: However, there are still considerable global uncertainties, including elevated oil prices and inflation, that warrant constant vigilance, said the department of economic affairs in its October review.

items.title: Microsoft eyes to raise at least $25 billion in first US bond since 2017
items.summary: Microsoft is seeking to raise at least $25 billion through its first US bond sale since 2017, testing investor appetite for AI-linked debt amid rising borrowing costs and spending concerns.

items.title: India can achieve $1 trillion exports target this fiscal despite global headwinds: Piyush Goyal
items.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal expressed confidence that India would achieve its $1 trillion exports target in 2026-27 despite global uncertainties. He said nine FTAs could open preferential market access to economies with a combined GDP of $60 trillion. Goods and services exports were estimated at $476.2 billion in April-September.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
items.summary: Indian equities rallied over 1% on Thursday as the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, crude prices eased and institutional buying strengthened sentiment. Sensex gained 905 points, while Nifty rose 238 points, adding nearly ₹5 lakh crore in market value.
